verdict.line: You're down trades until roughly level 6-7 while Parrrley pokes you down, but you win the moment he burns Remove Scurvy and the Test of Spirit tether he can't cleanse is still ticking.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's W (Remove Scurvy) clears crowd control, not the spirit Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) rips from his body — he can cleanse nothing about that echo, so every all-in should start with E landing first. Before that, he out-trades you at range with Q (Parrrley) and keg zoning, which is exactly why the 49% win rate over 102 games sits even: you lose the poke phase and win the item-timer phase.

theirWindow.what: He pre-places kegs and pokes with Q (5s cooldown, 625 range) for free poison stacks from his passive (Grog-Soaked Blade). Don't stand near a lit keg and don't trade autos into his Q range — just last-hit and eat the poison tick.

yourWindow.when: E (Test of Spirit) lands and connects
yourWindow.what: Hit E (900 range, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) then commit immediately with W (Harsh Lesson) and Q (Tentacle Smash). Remove Scurvy heals and clears CC but cannot remove the spirit, so the echoed damage is guaranteed — this is your only truly safe all-in window.

start.why: 50% win rate over 56 games and the higher pick (42.8%) because the passive block and regen directly offset Parrrley pokes and the Grog-Soaked Blade poison tick you'll be eating every trade.

boots.why: 70.5% pick and 50% win over 86 games — Parrrley is still a basic-attack-pattern ranged shot, and flat damage reduction cuts both that and his auto-poison harder than Mercury's Treads does here.

core.why: Core of the 64.3%-winrate path; the mana and cooldown it gives you lets you fire E/Q/W on cooldown through the poke phase instead of running dry.
Armor shred stacks across your W leap and tentacle hits, so your E-engage window does real damage instead of trading into his incidental armor.
The tankiness buffer for walking into Q range to land E — you need to survive the approach before the spirit-tether damage pays off.

situational.when: he leans on sustained poison and magic damage sources
he's landing clean Parrrley pokes and you need to heal back the burst to stay in trades
you're ahead and want to snowball isolated E all-ins faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest pick rate (40.7%) of the two listed pages — the proc rewards exactly the extended melee trades your tentacle-heal passive wants, and the max-HP scaling buys you the health buffer to survive to your item windows against his poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Exhaust posts the best measured win rate here (54.8% over 31.3% pick) — Exhaust shuts down his damage the instant you land E and commit, which is the exact window this matchup is built around. Flash+Teleport (46.9%, 47.8% pick) is the alternative if you want lane priority and faster scaling instead.

playing.title: Clear kegs before committing
playing.detail: Per the matchup read, destroy or avoid his placed kegs before you walk in — getting caught in a keg detonation during your E-engage turns a free trade into an even one.

playing.title: Lead every all-in with E
playing.detail: Test of Spirit's echo can't be cleansed by Remove Scurvy, so landing E before W or Q guarantees chip damage even if the rest of the trade goes wrong.

playing.title: Track his Remove Scurvy cooldown
playing.detail: It's 22/21/20/19/18s — once he's burned it recently for a heal or to clear a slow, he has no answer if you follow up E with a second commitment inside that window.

playing.title: Don't auto-trade into Parrrley range
playing.detail: His Q is a 625-range ranged shot on a 5s cooldown; walking up to melee-trade without using E first just eats free poke and poison stacks.

playing.title: Farm through levels 1-6
playing.detail: The data's own read is clear: he has the lane lead before your items come online, so prioritize CS and sustain from Doran's Shield over forcing fights.

playing.title: Position for tentacle uptime
playing.detail: Use W (Harsh Lesson) near terrain where your passive tentacles are already active — tentacle hits on him heal you and swing again on anything E has tethered.

playing.title: Save R for a guaranteed hit
playing.detail: Leap of Faith's cooldown (120/95/70/70/70s) is too long to throw away — only commit it when you're confident he can't simply walk out of range before it lands.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning — why the spirit-tether beats Remove Scurvy, why Parrrley wins the early trades, and the timing windows around them — is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful not to be hit with (E), and remove the kegs beforehand if you can. Engage when [E] lands as his (W) cannot cleanse his spirit. However, Gangplank has the upper hand early-game before you purchase items adequately, so farm lane while avoiding skirmishes.
